description.zh:
证书ID。  

> KeyId、SecretName和CertificateId必须且只能指定其中一个参数。
description.en:
The ID of the certificate.

> You must specify one and only one of the KeyId, SecretName, and CertificateId parameters.

description.zh:
密钥ID。主密钥（CMK）的全局唯一标识符。  

> KeyId、SecretName和CertificateId必须且只能指定其中一个参数。
description.en:
The ID of the key. This is the globally unique identifier (GUID) of the master key (CMK).

> You must specify one and only one of the KeyId, SecretName, and CertificateId parameters.

description.zh:
凭据名称。  

> KeyId、SecretName和CertificateId必须且只能指定其中一个参数。
description.en:
The name of the credential.

> You must specify one and only one of the KeyId, SecretName, and CertificateId parameters.

description.zh:
一个或多个标签键，多个标签键用半角逗号（,）间隔。  
您只需指定标签键，不需要指定标签值。  
长度为1~128个字节。
description.en:
One or more tag keys. Separate multiple tag keys with commas (,).
You need to specify only tag keys, not tag values.
The tag key can be 1 to 128 bytes in length.

title.zh: 删除用户主密钥或凭据的指定标签

descriptions.zh:
RAM用户或RAM角色调用该OpenAPI需要被授予的权限策略详情，请参见[访问控制](~~2767210~~)。

本文将提供一个示例，为ID为`08c33a6f-4e0a-4a1b-a3fa-7ddf****`的密钥解绑标签键为tagkey1、tagkey2的标签。
descriptions.en:
For information about the access policy that is required for a RAM user or RAM role to call this OpenAPI operation, see [Resource Access Management](~~2767210~~).

This topic provides an example of how to detach tags with the tag keys tagkey1 and tagkey2 from the key with the ID `08c33a6f-4e0a-4a1b-a3fa-7ddf****`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun kms untag-resource --key-id 08c33a6f-4e0a-4a1b-a3fa-7ddf0000 --tag-keys tagkey1_,_tagkey2 --secret-name MyDbC0000 --certificate-id 770dbe42-e146-43d1-a55a-1355db860000 --region cn-hangzhou
